product.name: BE-SMART Intelligent Solutions
product.description: AI solutions for breast imaging, including segmentation, tracking, and classification of abnormalities in various medical imaging modalities.

product.name: Cloud-Based AI Viewer
product.description: A platform that combines cloud technologies and AI for reviewing radiology reports and accessing AI models for mammography and ultrasound.

product.name: US-Elasto
product.description: An online and desktop platform for ultrasound elastography, providing tools for analyzing the elastic properties of tissues.

product.name: UltraSUGGEST AI
product.description: AI software that segments and classifies breast abnormalities in ultrasound images, offering quick diagnosis and automated reporting.

product.name: MammoSUGGEST AI
product.description: A cloud-based platform that detects and classifies breast abnormalities in mammograms, integrating with radiology workflows.
